en.text:
Holding [Block] grants one stack of 'Banshee's Wail' and charges the blade. Maximum of 9 stacks. Depleting your Sword Energy or ending your combo removes all stacks.

'Charged' Light Attacks consume 20% Sword Energy, dealing <pve 539 /> <pvp [389] /> damage followed by two hits of <pve 135 /> <pvp [95] /> damage. Continued attacks increase the damage of the main hit by 33% and grant one stack of 'Banshee's Wail' per damage instance (3 stacks per landed swing).

Performing a Heavy Attack while Banshee's Wail is active consumes all stacks and performs an overhead strike, dealing <pve 1054 /> <pvp [811] /> damage followed by two hits of <pve 198 /> <pvp [152] />. 

Heavy Attack Damage is increased based off the number of Banshee's Wail stacks:
• 1-3 Stacks: 0% increased damage
• 4-6 Stacks: 54% increased damage
• 7-9 Stacks: 109% increased damage
